user.title: Connect to a SlideShow player
user.description: Enter the address of the SlideShow web interface. Rooted devices normally use port 80, other devices use port 8080.

data_description.verify_ssl: SlideShow generates a self-signed certificate on first start, so leave this off unless you have uploaded your own.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with the SlideShow player
reauth_confirm.description: The credentials for this player were rejected. Enter the current web interface login.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the player. Check the host and port, and that the device is on the same network.
error.invalid_auth: The username or password was rejected by the player.
error.no_device_id: The player did not report a device ID and cannot be identified.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the player for its status. Lower values react faster but put more load on the device.

show_file.name: Show file
show_file.description: Displays a single file from the player's storage, overriding the current playlist.

file.name: File
file.description: Path to the file within SlideShow, for example image.jpg or nested/file.mp4.

length.name: Length
length.description: How long to display the file, in seconds.

zone_id.name: Zone ID
zone_id.description: Zone to display in, or "audio" for the audio playlist. Defaults to the main zone.

zone_name.name: Zone name
zone_name.description: Name of the zone to display in. Defaults to the main zone.

show_html.name: Show HTML
show_html.description: Renders a block of HTML on the screen, overriding the current playlist. Useful for pushing templated content from Home Assistant.

length.name: Length
length.description: How long to display the content, in seconds.

zone_id.name: Zone ID
zone_id.description: Zone to display in. Defaults to the main zone.

zone_name.name: Zone name
zone_name.description: Name of the zone to display in. Defaults to the main zone.

show_stream.name: Show stream
show_stream.description: Displays a video stream, overriding the current playlist.

length.name: Length
length.description: How long to display the stream, in seconds.

zone_id.name: Zone ID
zone_id.description: Zone to display in. Defaults to the main zone.

zone_name.name: Zone name
zone_name.description: Name of the zone to display in. Defaults to the main zone.

set_playlist.name: Set playlist
set_playlist.description: Switches a zone to a particular playlist. Give at least one of playlist ID, name or number.

length.name: Length
length.description: How long to play the playlist, in seconds. Omit to play until changed.

zone_id.name: Zone ID
zone_id.description: Zone to play in. Defaults to the main zone.

zone_name.name: Zone name
zone_name.description: Name of the zone to play in. Defaults to the main zone.

set_layout.name: Set screen layout
set_layout.description: Switches the player to a particular screen layout. Give at least one of layout ID or name.

length.name: Length
length.description: How long to show the layout, in seconds. Omit to show until changed.

synchronize.name: Synchronize files
synchronize.description: Triggers a file synchronization from an external server.

target.name: Target
target.description: Target file or folder within SlideShow.

clear_folder.name: Clear folder
clear_folder.description: Whether to empty the target folder before downloading.
